steps: Parked existing StarterPack Tools (Spear, Dagger) into ServerStorage
generate_mesh a slender falchion (single-edged forward-curved cleaver blade, crossguard, wrapped grip, round pommel), 3.6 studs
Captured right+iso angles to confirm the sword silhouette
save_mesh to persist the mesh+texture as durable owned assets
make_tool with the mesh as Handle -> StarterPack.Falchion
bind_hitbox damage 22 / reach 6 / cooldown 0.28 (short reach, moderate damage)

recipe.text: Falchion one-handed sword. Visual = generate_mesh (Cube) falchion profile, saved durable via save_mesh (asset 108238499207328). Toolified with the single blade MeshPart as Handle, moved to StarterPack. Fast-swing behavior state machine (windup 0.1 / active 0.12 / cooldown 0.28) and server-authoritative hitbox (22 dmg, 6-stud reach, 0.28 cooldown) bound on top. Grip fitting and animation left to later rungs per scope.
